properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued July 25 at 2:34PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
At 234 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was over Sweetwater Creek State
Park, or near City of South Fulton, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Up to 40 mph wind, frequent cloud to ground lightning and
heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect minor damage to tree limbs and blowing around of
light, unsecured objects. Heavy rain may cause temporary
street flooding especially in poor drainage areas.

Locations impacted include...
Atlanta, Douglasville, City of South Fulton, East Point, Union City,
Forest Park, College Park, Hapeville, Hartsfield-Jackson Airport,
Sweetwater Creek State Park, Six Flags Over Georgia, Cascade Heights,
Lakewood Park, Sandtown, and Mableton.
properties.instruction:
People outdoors should seek shelter immediately. If you can hear
thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning. Motorists
should slow down and be prepared for possible loss of control due to
hydroplaning.
properties.area: Cobb; North Fulton; Douglas; South Fulton; Clayton

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued July 25 at 2:33PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
properties.description:
A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Coastal waters from Murrells Inlet to South Santee River SC out 20
NM...

At 232 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm,
capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. The thunderstorm was
the northernmost along a line extending from near East Bank Buoy to
7 nm south of South Santee River Entrance to near Bull Breakers,
moving east at 20 knots.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until these storms pass. If caught on the open water,
prepare for deteriorating conditions. Make sure you and your crew are
wearing properly fitted life jackets.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Murrells Inlet to South Santee River SC out 20 NM

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 25 at 8:34AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 40.0 feet, Significant flooding reaches miles from the
main channel, flooding homes in the flood plain near Three Rivers
to Lake Corpus Christi. Up to 4 feet of water is in River Creek
Acres Subdivision, flooding several homes. Kellner Camp along
County Road 336 floods, with water several feet deep surrounding
homes. Antelope Lane is flooded cutting off access to J.I. Hailey
Subdivision at Jones River bend. Water approaches the base of homes
along the river in Buckeye Knoll Subdivision, 2 miles west of
Swinny Switch.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:15 AM CDT Saturday the stage was 1.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
Tuesday morning and continue rising to 40.4 feet Thursday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 40.6
feet on 07/11/2007.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
